overview: This Senate resolution formally tells the House of Representatives that the Senate has elected Jackie Barber as Secretary of the Senate. The Secretary is the Senate's chief administrative officer, overseeing its records, finances, and legislative staff. Sending this kind of notice is a standard step at the start of a new Congress. The Senate approved it on January 3, 2025, and sent the message to the House on January 6, 2025.
for: Supporters say the notice keeps the two chambers properly informed about who holds key Senate offices.
against: Critics say the resolution is a routine formality that does not change any law or policy.
